summary: KNOT Offshore Partners LP (KNOP) filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, announcing its subsidiary KNOT Shuttle Tankers AS agreed to acquire Knutsen Canadian Chartering AS, owner of the shuttle tanker Hedda Knutsen, from Knutsen NYK Offshore Tankers AS. Purchase price is $113.0 million less $89.4 million debt plus $0.8 million capitalized fees, netting approximately $24.4 million, subject to working capital adjustments. The vessel operates under a Petrobras time charter expiring November 2034 with a five-year option. The board and independent Conflicts Committee approved, advised by outside financial and legal counsel. Separately, KNOP completed a $225 million refinancing. Watch for closing adjustments and charter stability.
